actors.name: Apple Inc.
actors.private_context: Apple has not yet publicly confirmed the keynote speaker for Macworld San Francisco 2007. Internally, they are considering options and may have a decision but have not announced it.

actors.name: Steve Jobs
actors.private_context: Steve Jobs is the CEO of Apple and has been the keynote speaker at previous Macworld events. He is aware that the conference is approaching and that a decision about the keynote speaker needs to be made.

shared_context: Macworld San Francisco 2007 is scheduled for January 8-12, 2007. The opening keynote is traditionally a major event. As of December 1, 2006, Apple has not publicly confirmed who will deliver the keynote. The conference begins on January 8, 2007 at 9:00 AM PST.

starting_events.description: The simulation begins. Apple has not yet publicly confirmed the keynote speaker for Macworld San Francisco 2007.

resolution: Resolve YES if, before the hard cutoff at 2007-01-08T18:00:00-08:00, Apple Inc. publicly confirms (via an official press release, announcement on its website, or other official channel) that Steve Jobs will be the opening keynote speaker for Macworld San Francisco 2007. Otherwise resolve NO.
